meta.title: Robust Label - Lychen
meta.description: Discover the Lychen Robust Label, a unique system to measure the resilience and autonomy of territories, from transition to regeneration.

hero.title: Robust: The Scale of Resilience and Autonomy
hero.description: A single label to measure robustness, from transition to the regeneration of life. A unique scale from 1 to 10 for all systems (cities, companies, associations, products).

transition.title: Transition
transition.subtitle: Levels 1 to 3
transition.description: The system initiates its model change. It implements initial initiatives to reduce negative impact and move towards sustainable practices.

preservation.title: Preservation
preservation.subtitle: Levels 4 to 7
preservation.description: The system preserves the ecosystem. It has reached a balance where its activities no longer harm the environment and maintain existing resources.

regeneration.title: Regeneration
regeneration.subtitle: Levels 8 to 10
regeneration.description: The system regenerates the surrounding ecosystem. It aims for complete autonomy and actively contributes to the restoration of life and biodiversity.

gamification.title: Coherent & Measurable Gamification
gamification.description: The Robust Label allows comparing and validating the efforts of each actor, whatever their nature. The larger the system, the harder the level is to reach, highlighting agile small local initiatives.

vision.title: A Unique Vision
vision.description: By speaking only of 'Robust Level X', we simplify communication while maintaining scientific precision on real impact. It is a universal recognition tool for ecological transition.
